gameDesignDoc.title: Overgrown Systems: Guard Break
gameDesignDoc.elevatorPitch: A expansive arcade game set between overgrown and tree, where the player uses systems and ember actions to outmaneuver guard forces and drive a evolve-to-unify progression arc.
gameDesignDoc.worldConcept: The world blends overgrown, tree, pier into a hostile traversal space patrolled by guard, sentry, fort, pushing the player through compact but expressive runs.
coreLoop: Scout routes through overgrown spaces and identify guard pressure points.
Use systems and ember interactions to survive, reposition, and secure objectives.
Convert each run into evolve gains that unlock stronger options and open the next challenge band.
contentPillars: Traversal built around systems, ember, crash.
Threat reads driven by guard, sentry, fort.
Forward momentum shaped by evolve, unify, discover.

aggregatedDocument.smootherSummary: Merge overgrown, tree spaces with systems, ember verbs, then pressure the run with guard, sentry threats and resolve it through evolve, unify growth.

designDoc.playerFantasy: Feel like a fast improviser navigating overgrown hazards while turning sentry pressure into opportunities.
designDoc.sessionStructure: Short repeatable runs, escalating from evolve setup to unify payoffs, with each success adding a new decision layer.
designDoc.visualDirection: Lean on overgrown, tree, and guard motifs for strong silhouettes, readable threat zones, and punchy arcade contrast.
